description: An inline review comment was added to a pull request's diff.

type.description: Payload type (same as the event type).

pullRequest.description: The pull request, as of this event.

path.description: Path of the commented file, relative to the repository root.

line.description: Diff line the comment applies to; null for file-level or outdated comments.

reviewId.description: ID of the review the comment belongs to.

inReplyToId.description: ID of the comment this one replies to; null when it starts a new thread.
